codeReview.summary: The feature adds substantial edge-case fixture coverage and integrity tooling, but two scope-critical gaps remain: device-traversal fixtures/scenarios are not actually implemented, and clean-checkout reproducibility for large-file edge cases is broken.

issues.description: Feature scope explicitly includes symlink/device traversal, but no one-device fixture set is built. `build_platform_metadata` defines a `one-device` metadata entry (line 357), yet `BUILDERS` only constructs seven categories (ignore/hidden/binary/symlink/large/zero/max) and omits any one-device fixture builder; corresponding edge scenarios in `manifests/scenarios.json` (lines 196-414) include symlink cases but no one-device case.

Edge fixture setup is only triggered when `tests/edge-cases/ignore-source` is missing, so partial fixture trees are not repaired. In this commit, `tests/edge-cases/large-file/large.txt` is intentionally ignored (`.gitignore` line 36) and not tracked, but `validate_fixture_integrity.py` only checks large-file size if `large.txt` exists (line 385) and does not fail when it is absent. On a clean checkout, edge large-file scenarios can run without the intended large fixture, violating reproducible edge-case setup expectations.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared guidance requires deterministic, machine-auditable artifacts, but there is no explicit convention in AGENTS/library enforcing that manifest-critical fixtures must be source-tracked or always regenerated before parity runs.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md says to keep artifacts deterministic/reproducible, while this feature relies on ignored generated fixtures (`.gitignore` lines 35-36) and `run_matrix.py` only conditionally regenerates edge fixtures (line 302), allowing clean-checkout drift.

summary: Fail: edge-case coverage is incomplete for device traversal, and large-file edge-case reproducibility is not reliable from clean checkout due conditional setup and missing required fixture enforcement.
